latest_release.name: Password Manager 2026.10.1 (21986)
latest_release.body:
# Overview
* Create a new login from the generator tab
* Improved keyboard navigation
* Fixed autofill crashes on Android 10
* Fixed autofill selection being lost after editing an item

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at release/2026.10-rc65 -->

## What's Changed
### ✨ Community Highlight
* [PM-43768] fix: preserve biometric unlock after transient Keystore authorization failure by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7399
### :shipit: Feature Development
* PM-43004: feat: Add ability to create login from Generator by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7453
* PM-29851: feat: The interactive border should only be displayed if the focus was granted by a keyboard by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7468
### 🐛 Bug fixes
* PM-44005: bug: Add updated focused border states for most UI elements by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7441
* [PM-44412] fix: Keep autofill context after editing cipher by @aj-rosado in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7448
* PM-44005: bug: Add focus state to hypertext links by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7455
* [PM-44660] fix: Avoid Android 10 autofill crash from missing InlinePresentationSpec class by @aj-rosado in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7456
* [PM-43385] fix: Show correct cipher count for nested collections by @andrebispo5 in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7452
* [PM-16915] fix: Disable custom field name confirmation for blank names by @andrebispo5 in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7484
* [PM-24364] fix: [Android] Import logins card is not dismissed [bug-factory poc] by @andrebispo5 in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7486
* [PM-33393] fix: TOTP auth key can be shown by users without permission [bug-factory poc] by @andrebispo5 in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7487
### ⚙️ Maintenance
* Crowdin Pull by @bw-ghapp[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7443
* Chore: Simplify bitwarden shapes by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7445
* Chore: Update gradle wrapper and AGP by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7446
* Chore: Deprecate v1 cipher payloads by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7449
* Chore: Add Autofill logging for debug purposes by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7450
* Stale issue warning and closure automation by @mpbw2 in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7437
* Chore: Update gitignore to skip worktrees by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7454
* Crowdin Pull by @bw-ghapp[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7473
* [PM-33888] ci: Improve PR labels enforcement  by @vvolkgang in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7435
* [PM-34536] ci: Flag breaking changes in SDK update PRs by @mpbw2 in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7478
* [PM-33888] ci: Run label enforcement from the labeler workflow by @vvolkgang in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7485
* Chore: Remove usage of deprecated NativeClipboard by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7480
### 📦 Dependency Updates
* Update SDK to 4.0.0-9248-c815b283 by @bw-ghapp[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7438
* Update Google privileged browsers list by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7442
* Update SDK to 4.0.0-9318-3b2c8fc3 by @bw-ghapp[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7447
* deps: Update Firebase BOM to v35.0.0 by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7458
* deps: Update KSP and Kover to their latest versions by @david-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/android/pull/7462
